sections.title: Call me, stop me
sections.intro: Say the assistant's name first, then your request. You can say the name and the request together: “Adanna, take a picture of me”.

sections.title: Open things
sections.intro: Say where you want to go. These work from any screen.

sections.title: Camera
sections.intro: On the camera screens you can say these without touching the phone. Say “pause” at any time and I will stop and listen for your request.

sections.title: After I describe something
sections.intro: I keep the photo for a few minutes so you can ask more about it.

sections.title: Screen and text
sections.intro: Everything on the Settings screen can be changed by voice.

sections.title: Sound and speaking
sections.intro: How loud, how fast, and who talks to you.

sections.title: Voice and language
sections.intro: Adanna is a woman's voice, Bola is a man's. Both are the same assistant.

sections.title: Safety and location
sections.intro: Needs the phone's location. Texts your emergency contact only when you ask.

sections.title: Hands-free
sections.intro: For when you cannot touch the phone at all.

commands.title: I need help
commands.note: Counts down for a few seconds, then texts your location to your emergency contact. Say “cancel” to stop it.

commands.title: Take a photo
commands.note: On the mirror it takes the photo at once. From any other screen it opens the mirror and takes it.

commands.title: Take the photo now (on the mirror)
Pause (then speak your request)
commands.note: Works even while I am talking. After you say it I stop, and listen for what you need.

commands.title: Change the language I speak to you in
commands.note: Say the language's name. Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo are translated for you.

commands.title: Access granted (hands-free)
commands.note: After this I keep listening after every answer, so you never need to touch the screen or say my name.

commands.title: Call the assistant
commands.note: Say the name, wait for “Listening”, then say your request. Or say it all at once: “Bola, read this”. The phone must be unlocked with the app open. Teach me your accent in Settings, Teach me your voice.

commands.title: Stop talking
commands.note: Works while I am talking. On the camera screens, stopping also pauses and listens for your next request.

commands.title: Set my emergency contact (I'll ask you)
phrases: i want to set my emergency contact
i want to add an emergency contact
i want to change my emergency contact
help me set my emergency contact
help me add an emergency contact
who should i set as my emergency contact
let me set my emergency contact
commands.note: I open the Emergency contact page and ask for the name. Say it, or spell it letter by letter. Then say the number digit by digit, and say “save”. You can correct any step by saying “no” or “spell it”.
